\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar,bar width=8pt,width=9cm,height=6cm,xmin=.5,xmax=2.5,ymin=0,ymax=7,
  enlargelimits=false,xtick={1,2},legend pos=north west,legend columns=2]
  \addplot coordinates {(1,2) (2,4)};
  \addplot+[orange,mark=*] coordinates {(1,3) (2,2)};
  \addplot+[draw=purple] coordinates {(1,2) (2,3)};
  \addplot[draw=blue,fill] coordinates {(1,4) (2,1)};
  \legend{Cycle,Color,Pen,Bare fill}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
